create.name: Roy Sunley
create.bio:
Roy Sunley is a healer, teacher and Spiritualist medium who works in London and the south-east of England. He turned to healing after a long senior career in business, beginning with Usui Reiki, in which he went on to qualify as a Master Teacher, and later adding Quantum-Touch, which he practises and teaches as a certified Level 1 instructor. He belongs to the College of Psychic Studies as a full member, and has also trained in mindfulness and meditation to diploma level. His travels in search of healing traditions have taken him to Peru, where he learned shamanic journeying, to Japan and to the Rongbuk Monastery near Everest.

He teaches small groups of six to eight at Horn Hill Village Hall near Chalfont St Peter in Buckinghamshire. His two-day Quantum-Touch Level 1 course covers the breathing and body-awareness techniques of the method, chakra work and distance healing, and ends with the official Level 1 certificate. As a medium he serves Spiritualist churches across London and the Home Counties, among them the London Spiritual Mission, and offers private sittings for those seeking contact with loved ones in spirit. He also runs one-day workshops in mediumship and spiritual development, and shamanic courses on journeying with spirit animals, guides and ancestors.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch Level 1 course
courses.description: A two-day Level 1 workshop for six to eight people at Horn Hill Village Hall in Buckinghamshire, ending with the official Level 1 certificate. It teaches the breathing and awareness techniques of the method, with chakra work and a spiritual element Roy brings to the class.

courses.title: Mediumship sittings
courses.description: Private sittings in which Roy seeks messages from loved ones and guides in spirit, offered alongside his public demonstrations at Spiritualist churches. People often come for guidance at a turning point in relationships, home or work.

courses.title: Mediumship, spiritual development and shamanic workshops
courses.description: One-day workshops for every level of experience on developing mediumship and working with spirit, usually held at the London Spiritual Mission. He also runs shamanic courses on journeying to meet spirit animals, guides and ancestors.
